words.text: Good afternoon, class. Don't stand there gawping, find a broom.
words.speaker: Madam Hooch

words.text: Stand on the left of it. Right hand out, flat, over the handle.
words.speaker: Madam Hooch

words.text: Now, firmly, and mean it: say 'Up!'
words.speaker: Madam Hooch

words.text: It's going on its own! I can't stop it, help!
words.speaker: Neville

words.text: Nobody moves! Feet on the grass until I'm back, or you'll answer for it.
words.speaker: Madam Hooch
